title: Airtight cookie jars
text: Airtight cookie jars. I love this jar... it is plastic, not glass.. but it seals well.  I use it to hold my grandson's cookie treats. Would hold anything you want to be airtight - cookies... crackers... etc... The hole is easy to get into.. It's a good size and easy to clean.  Honestly I would buy again.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips 3.0 Qt POP Medium Cookie Jar - Airtight Food Storage - for Snacks and More, White and Clear
features: Medium 3-quart size is great for holding grains, flour, cookies and more
Airtight POP seal keeps contents fresh
Pop-up button doubles as a handle to remove lid
Large, circular opening makes it easy to access contents
Flat back allows Jar to sit flush against kitchen wall or backsplash
BPA Free Plastic. Silicone gasket is dishwasher safe. Hand wash all other parts.
description: The OXO POP Medium Jar combines the airtight seal of POP Containers with the body of a classic cookie jar. The unique pop-up button mechanism creates an airtight seal with one touch, and the button doubles as a convenient handle. A large, circular opening makes it easy to access your snacks, while the Jar’s flat back creates an attractive, space-saving countertop display. 3-quart capacity. All POP containers are BPA free.
